*Effective October 23, 2026. This policy covers the website at slamdunk.bet, operated by Slam Dunk Betting Services LLC ("Slam Dunk Bets", "we").*

## What this site collects

This website has no accounts, forms, or comment sections. It collects **anonymous usage analytics** through Google Analytics 4: pages viewed, approximate location derived from a truncated IP address, device and browser type, the site that referred you, and clicks on our subscribe and app links. Google Analytics sets cookies to tell repeat visits apart. We use this to understand which pages and links are useful; we don't sell it, and we can't identify you from it.

It also loads the **X (Twitter) conversion pixel** to measure our ads on X (see Advertising below).

You can opt out with the [Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on](https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout), by blocking cookies for this site in your browser, or by using a content blocker.

## Services with their own policies

Subscribing, paying, and receiving picks all happen on other companies' platforms, each governed by its own privacy policy:

- **Sharpduel** and **Whop** handle checkout, billing, and subscription management. We never see your card details.
- **Discord** hosts the community where picks are posted.
- **The Slam Dunk Dashboard** at app.slamdunk.bet asks you to sign in with Discord or Google so it can confirm you're an active subscriber. It stores the account identifier those services return and nothing else from your profile.

## Advertising and affiliate links

This site shows no ads and has no affiliate links. We do advertise **on X**, and to measure those ads every page loads X's conversion pixel. It lets X record that you visited and whether you clicked through to subscribe, and match that to an ad you saw or clicked on X, using cookies and identifiers X sets. X handles that data under the [X Privacy Policy](https://x.com/en/privacy); you can limit ad personalization in your X account's privacy settings, and blocking third-party cookies or using a content blocker stops the pixel. If we add ads or affiliate links to the site itself, any page that contains them will say so plainly, and this policy will be updated.

## Children

This site and our services are for adults 21 and over. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 21.

## Changes and contact

If this policy changes, we'll update the effective date above. Questions about your data: [slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com](mailto:slamdunkbettingservices@gmail.com).
